jobs.occupation: Commercial Project Manager / Project Controller (f/m/d) for Germany (Vertriebscontroller/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Project Controller / Commercial Project Manager (f/m/d), you will be the financial lead for a portfolio of complex real estate construction projects within Siemens Energy. Acting as the trusted finance business partner to the Real Estate Project Management organization, you will oversee budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and investment approvals while ensuring full compliance with IFRS and local accounting standards. Working closely with colleagues from Accounting, Operations, Procurement, Legal, and Real Estate, you will provide transparent financial insights that support strategic decisions and drive successful project delivery.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead the commercial execution of a dedicated portfolio of real estate construction projects, including budgeting, forecasting, cost recognition, and financial reporting
* Prepare robust investment approvals by developing business cases, profitability analyses, and discounted cash flow models for strategic construction initiatives
* Establish accurate financial project structures in SAP, including Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and ensure alignment with approved project budgets and schedules
* Ensure timely month-end closing, accurate project accounting, and full compliance with IFRS and Local GAAP throughout the project lifecycle
* Present clear financial performance reports, highlight cost deviations, and provide actionable recommendations to senior management and key stakeholders
* Partner with cross-functional teams across Finance, Real Estate, Operations, Procurement, and Legal to enable informed commercial decision-making and successful project execution

What You Bring

* A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or Economics; a master's degree or CPA qualification is an advantage
* Longstanding professional experience in Finance, Controlling, or Project Finance, ideally within construction, infrastructure, or capital investment projects
* Strong understanding of Financial Planning & Analysis/Business Case Models in preparation of investment approvals (e.g. proof of profitability & discounted cash flow calculation
* Proven experience managing CAPEX projects, annual budgets, forecasting, free cash flow, depreciation, and financial reporting for complex project portfolios
* Solid knowledge of IFRS and Local GAAP, with hands-on experience in PP&E (CAPEX) accounting and strong SAP expertise, ideally across PS, CO, and FI modules
* Business fluent English communication skills

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

jobs.occupation: AI Strategic Pursuits Sales Specialist, Specialists Team Germany, Switzerland and CEE, AGS - WWSO EM (Betriebswirt/in - allgemeine Betriebswirtschaft)

jobs.description:
AI is the largest platform shift since the cloud itself, and the companies who move first will define their industries for a decade. AWS Enterprise works with the organizations making those moves: global brands, energy leaders, mobility operators, insurers, retailers. The AI Strategic Pursuits team leads the most strategic AI opportunities across these accounts, from the first board conversation to signed agreement and production impact.
As an AI Strategic Pursuit Lead, you own the commercial motion behind transformational AI initiatives. You operate inside the account team alongside Account Executives, Solutions Architects and Specialists, and you own the AI opportunity end to end: shaping the executive narrative, building the business case, orchestrating stakeholders across customer C-suites and AWS leadership, and driving deals through to close. You are the person a CEO calls when they decide AI is a board priority rather than an experiment.
This is not a program management role and not a technical role. It is a commercial leadership role for people who translate ambiguity into strategy, strategy into a deal, and a deal into measurable customer outcomes.
Role is based out of Munich, Germany; responsibilities will cover segments and regions across the Germany, Switzerland and CEE area.

Key job responsibilities
Own a portfolio of strategic AI pursuits across Germany, Switzerland and CEE's largest enterprise accounts, with direct accountability for pipeline and revenue outcomes.
Build and present board-level business cases: value quantification, transformation roadmaps, investment logic.
Lead executive engagement from first briefing through negotiation, including C-suite workshops, executive briefings, and multi-stakeholder alignment
Bring together the right programs and investment vehicles to advance AI transformation at scale at customers.
Shape large, multi-year agreements together with Account Teams, including commercial structure and executive sponsorship.
Turn wins into references: document outcomes and bring customer stories to industry stages
Feed field insight back into the AWS AI go-to-market strategy and mechanisms and drive repeatability of AWS AI transformation approach to help customers adopt AI safely and at scale.

A day in the life
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

About the team
AI Strategic Pursuits is a new team inside AWS Enterprise Sales, built to match the moment. We hire people with bar raising depth and drive who chose the field over the deck, enterprise sellers who closed the deals others called impossible, operators who built businesses inside large organizations. We are small by design, senior by default, and measured on outcomes our customers announce publicly.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working closely with and advising senior executives of an organization or equivalent
- Track record leading large, complex deals or transformation initiatives from origination to signature
- Experience building business cases and value narratives for board-level audiences
- Bar raising in senior stakeholder management and communication
- Fluent in English (verbally, in writing)

Preferred qualifications

- Background at a top-tier strategy consultancy combined with commercial line experience
- Experience selling or advising on AI, data, or cloud transformation on senior executive level
- Experience operating in matrixed global organizations with distributed decision making

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager Warehouse Retrofit & WMS Transformation (f/m/d) (Logistiker/in)
jobs.description:
BERNER pushing the limits – for those who dare more
Making a choice about your career and your employer is a choice about your future - a future where you will invest your passion and a large portion of your time, energy, and capacity.  

Are you ready to take responsibility for a strategically important logistics transformation program - from planning through to successful implementation?

For one of our Powerhouses we plan to re-design the complete Warehouse Set-Up incl. a new WMS, you will take over the full project responsibility for the transformation on all relevant sites.

The aim of this multi-year transformation program is to develop our existing logistics sites into a future-proof Solution. The program combines warehouse retrofitting, intralogistics, automation and the implementation of a new Warehouse Management System – all while maintaining ongoing operations.

YOUR TASKS

- You will take end-to-end responsibility for managing the multi-year warehouse retrofit, intralogistics and WMS transformation program across our logistics sites.
- You will lead several cross-functional workstreams and coordinate internal and external project partners from Operations, IT, Intralogistics, Construction, Finance, Purchasing and other departments.
- You will be responsible for managing project timelines, budgets, quality, risks, dependencies and business continuity.
- You will oversee the implementation and integration of the new WMS, including process design, testing, migration, cutover and ramp-up.
- You will coordinate retrofit, automation and construction activities, ranging from conveyor technology and shuttle systems to high-bay warehouses, pick & pack operations and expansions.
- You will ensure that construction and transformation activities are carried out during ongoing operations with minimal impact on delivery capability and service levels.
- You will manage external planners, suppliers, IT and intralogistics partners, as well as relevant approval processes.
- You will prepare and facilitate Steering Committees and Management Reviews and develop decision-making documents for Senior Management and the Executive Board.

YOUR PROFILE

- You have several years of experience as an Overall Project Manager, Program Manager or Senior Project Lead in complex warehouse, logistics or intralogistics projects.
- You have a proven track record of successfully implementing retrofit, brownfield or comparable transformation projects during ongoing warehouse operations.
- You have extensive experience in WMS implementations or migrations, including testing, cutover and ramp-up.
- You are familiar with automated conveyor technology, shuttle and goods-to-person systems, high-bay warehouses, pick & pack operations and material flow processes.
- You have experience in managing large-scale investment projects and complex, cross-functional project structures.
- You demonstrate strong stakeholder management skills and communicate confidently at all levels, from the shop floor to Executive Management and the Executive Board.
- You have a structured, solution-oriented and assertive approach and maintain an overall perspective, even in highly complex project environments.
- Very good German and English language skills, along with a strong willingness to work on-site, particularly in Künzelsau and Ingelfingen, complete your profile.

WHY BERNER?

- Commuting allowance

- Company pension scheme  
- Opportunities for further training  
- Technically modern equipped workplace  
- Company restaurant in Künzelsau or meal vouchers in Cologne  
- Attractive conditions for our products in the BERNER online shop 

Apply Now – We’re Excited to Meet You! 

Please submit your application via our online form, including your availability and salary expectations.

Join our team and shape the future with us!

Help Accelerate Industrial Decarbonization

Join exceptional people from around the world to solve some of the world's toughest energy challenges, make a real impact, and enjoy the adventure of building the future of industrial decarbonization together.

As our Manufacturing & Industrialisation Engineer, you will help turn our proprietary solar-thermal technology into scalable, repeatable production systems that can be deployed around the world.

This is a hands-on technical role spanning two unique manufacturing environments: component production through external manufacturing partners, and the construction of large solar fields as disciplined, measurable production systems. Working with experienced colleagues, suppliers and project teams, you will contribute from early concepts and specifications through supplier delivery, commissioning, ramp-up and continuous improvement, taking increasing ownership as your capability grows.

Your Impact

Your work will help turn innovative engineering into reliable production and large-scale deployment.

You’ll shape how our technology is manufactured and deployed—from developing production processes and equipment to improving how solar fields are built in the field. Working across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Project Delivery, Construction and HSE, you’ll help create safer, more efficient and repeatable ways of delivering our technology at scale.

What You'll Do

Develop Manufacturing Processes

- Support senior engineers in developing production concepts, equipment specifications, technical evaluations, trials and acceptance plans.
- Take increasing ownership of defined manufacturing processes, tooling packages, supplier actions and site-production workstreams as your capability grows.
- Develop manufacturing processes, machine concepts and equipment specifications for GlassPoint's proprietary concentrating mirrors and film panels.
- Apply DFMA, process capability, standard work, line balancing, cycle-time and capacity analysis to improve safety, quality, output and cost.

Build Tools and Production Systems

- Create clear process documentation, work instructions, layouts, standard work and equipment records.
- Help turn solar-field construction into a repeatable field-production system with defined workflows, work packages, tooling, crew structures and productivity measures.
- Develop or specify production equipment, tools, jigs, fixtures, gauges and handling solutions suited to factories and remote sites.
- Choose the right level of automation - from simple manual aids through mechanised tooling to automated equipment - based on volume, workforce capability, maintainability and economics.

Build Tools and Production Systems

- Work with external equipment builders, integrators and manufacturing partners through technical evaluation, design review, FAT, SAT, commissioning and ramp-up.
- Collect and analyse process data, cycle times, defects, downtime and labour productivity, turning evidence into practical improvement actions.
- Work across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Project Delivery, Construction and HSE, capturing lessons and improving each subsequent deployment.

Commission and Continuously Improve 

- Collect and analyse process data, cycle times, defects, downtime and labour productivity, turning evidence into practical improvement actions.
- Work across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Project Delivery, Construction and HSE, capturing lessons and improving each subsequent deployment.

Who You Are

You’re a practical and curious engineer who wants to understand how products are made, how production systems work and how they can be improved.

You enjoy learning through direct experience in factories, supplier facilities and project sites. You’re reliable, adaptable and comfortable working through engineering problems, analysing data and getting hands-on with production processes and equipment. You’re ready to learn from experienced colleagues and take increasing ownership as your capability grows.

Ideally, you'll bring:

- Degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, Production Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
- Typically 10+ years of relevant manufacturing or industrialisation experience, with direct responsibility for production processes, equipment or line deployment.
- A strong record of specifying, procuring, commissioning and ramping production machinery, tooling or automated/semi-automated systems.
- Experience leading engineers, project teams or technical workstreams; formal people-management experience is desirable.
- Deep practical knowledge of DFMA, process capability, tolerancing, error-proofing, line balancing, standard work and continuous improvement.
- Confidence working with equipment builders, system integrators and outsourced manufacturers, including FAT and SAT.
- Experience with large assemblies, modular systems, construction operations or field-deployed production is highly desirable.
- Practical, commercially aware and comfortable making structured decisions with incomplete information.
- Strong English communication skills and willingness to travel internationally, sometimes for extended project phases.

What You'll Find at GlassPoint

- Real ownership and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact from day one.
- Exceptional colleagues from diverse disciplines who challenge, support, and learn from each other.
- Complex challenges that require curiosity, collaboration, and innovation.
- An international team united by a shared purpose and ambitious goals.
- The adventure of helping build the future of industrial decarbonization.

We value inclusion and foster a culture of belonging, welcoming team members of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, gender identity, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We have zero tolerance for discrimination, harassment, bullying, or retaliation.

GlassPoint helps heavy industry decarbonize by replacing fuel-based steam with solar thermal heat. This reduces energy costs and improves long-term energy security. We’re a proven technology, already operating some of the world’s largest solar steam projects across sun-belt regions in oil and gas, metals, and mining.

jobs.description:
What to Expect

Please submit your CV in English in order to be considered for the role.This role is available in Manchester, Amsterdam, and Berlin.This is a 12-month fixed-term contract with the possibility of extension.The Installer Support team serves as an escalation point for our network of channel partners who distribute, install and service residential Tesla energy products. We strive to empower our channel partners to provide the best end-customer experience possible, and we are an endpoint for determining next steps and solutions for many situations.Installer Support Engineering Technicians offer real-time diagnostics and solutions for trained on-site technicians during installation and maintenance of Tesla’s residential solar, storage and home charging energy products. Strong candidates for this role will already have knowledge in the residential energy industry. Applicants should expect to become a subject matter expert (SME) with Tesla’s energy products with the ability to remotely access and troubleshoot equipment.This is an exciting, fast-paced and rewarding role, and a fantastic opportunity to dig deep into our innovative products while collaborating with some of the most talented people in the world!

What You’ll Do

- Provide top-tier support for live on-site or off-site technical issues regarding residential energy products via phone, chat, email or other channels
- Follow best practices in case handling, follow-up, and documenting interactions and work performed with great detail
- Become highly knowledgeable in the technical operation and complexities of Tesla’s energy products
- Understand and troubleshoot proprietary power electronics systems and their supporting components
- Read and understand single-line diagrams as they pertain to PV and storage systems as well as load and meter component placement
- Review operational logs in proprietary and non-proprietary applications
- Identify trending issues, collect information and report findings to leadership and engineering teams
- Identify process and knowledge gaps and submit feedback that leads to better training and resources
- Become a subject matter expert (SME) in residential Tesla energy products.
- Utilise software including Linux environments, SSH, and more for advanced troubleshooting

What You’ll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in a technical or engineering field, or a minimum of 2+ years’ experience in a technician role
- Fluency in English and Spanish is required for this role 
- Ability to independently make decisions and solve problems with limited direction
- Outstanding written and verbal interpersonal communication skills
- Experience and understanding of customer service, technical support and engineering environments
- Ability to document interactions and steps clearly, accurately and with detail
- Ability to prioritize workflows effectively according to multiple criteria
- Understanding of electrical theory and experience with emphasis on AC/DC power systems or other electronic systems, devices and components
- Experience troubleshooting metering and communications issues involving many variables
- Understanding of commercial electrical metering, energy flow, power factor, and phase rotation
- Electrical engineering knowledge and/or experience is a plus

Help Accelerate Industrial Decarbonization

Join exceptional people from around the world to solve some of the world's toughest energy challenges, make a real impact, and enjoy the adventure of building the future of industrial decarbonization together.

As our Senior Manufacturing & Industrialization Engineer (m/f/d), you will play a key role in turning our proprietary solar-thermal technology into scalable, repeatable production systems that can be deployed around the world.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role spanning two unique manufacturing environments: component production through external manufacturing partners, and the construction of large solar fields as disciplined, measurable production systems. You will take work from early concept and specification through supplier delivery, commissioning, ramp-up and continuous improvement.

Your Impact

Your work will help turn innovative engineering into reliable production and large-scale deployment.

You’ll shape how our technology is manufactured and deployed—from developing production processes and equipment to improving how solar fields are built in the field. Working across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Project Delivery, Construction and HSE, you’ll help create safer, more efficient and repeatable ways of delivering our technology at scale.

What You'll Do

Lead Manufacturing & Industrialization

- Lead manufacturing and industrialization strategy for assigned products, component families and solar-field work packages.
- Own complex equipment and industrialization programmes, including technical scope, interfaces, risk, schedule, investment and acceptance.
- Provide technical leadership, coaching and task direction to engineers and other contributors, helping build GlassPoint's manufacturing-engineering capability.
- Lead cross-functional reviews and present clear process-selection, investment and risk recommendations to senior stakeholders.

Develop Production Systems & Equipment

- Develop manufacturing processes, machine concepts and equipment specifications for GlassPoint's proprietary concentrating mirrors and film panels.
- Help turn solar-field construction into a repeatable field-production system with defined workflows, work packages, tooling, crew structures and productivity measures.
- Develop or specify production equipment, tools, jigs, fixtures, gauges and handling solutions suited to factories and remote sites.
- Work with external equipment builders, integrators and manufacturing partners through technical evaluation, design review, FAT, SAT, commissioning and ramp-up.

Improve Performance & Scale

- Apply DFMA, process capability, standard work, line balancing, cycle-time and capacity analysis to improve safety, quality, output and cost.
- Choose the right level of automation—from simple manual aids through mechanised tooling to automated equipment—based on volume, workforce capability, maintainability and economics.
- Work across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Project Delivery, Construction and HSE, capturing lessons and improving each subsequent deployment.

Who You Are

- You're someone who enjoys solving complex manufacturing challenges and turning ambitious technology into practical, scalable production.
- You know the best solution isn't always the most automated one and can balance quality, safety, cost and output with maintainability and simplicity.
- You enjoy working hands-on with engineering teams, suppliers and manufacturing partners, and are comfortable travelling internationally, including to remote project locations and for extended visits during commissioning and ramp-up.
- Most importantly, you're excited to influence both the product and how it is manufactured and deployed at scale.

Ideally, you'll bring:

- Degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, Production Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
- Typically 10+ years of relevant manufacturing or industrialisation experience, with direct responsibility for production processes, equipment or line deployment.
- A strong record of specifying, procuring, commissioning and ramping production machinery, tooling or automated/semi-automated systems.
- Experience leading engineers, project teams or technical workstreams; formal people-management experience is desirable.
- Deep practical knowledge of DFMA, process capability, tolerancing, error-proofing, line balancing, standard work and continuous improvement.
- Confidence working with equipment builders, system integrators and outsourced manufacturers, including FAT and SAT.
- Experience with large assemblies, modular systems, construction operations or field-deployed production is highly desirable.
- Practical, commercially aware and comfortable making structured decisions with incomplete information.
- Strong English communication skills and willingness to travel internationally, sometimes for extended project phases.

What You'll Find at GlassPoint

- Real ownership and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact from day one.
- Exceptional colleagues from diverse disciplines who challenge, support, and learn from each other.
- Complex challenges that require curiosity, collaboration, and innovation.
- An international team united by a shared purpose and ambitious goals.
- The adventure of helping build the future of industrial decarbonization.

We value inclusion and foster a culture of belonging, welcoming team members of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, gender identity, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We have zero tolerance for discrimination, harassment, bullying, or retaliation.

GlassPoint helps heavy industry decarbonize by replacing fuel-based steam with solar thermal heat. This reduces energy costs and improves long-term energy security. We’re a proven technology, already operating some of the world’s largest solar steam projects across sun-belt regions in oil and gas, metals, and mining.

We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly’s operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

What you will do

- Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
- Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
- Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.
- Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products.
- Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution.
- Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery.
- Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes.
- Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations.

What we are looking for

- Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments.
- Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes.
- Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance.
- Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more.
- Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.
- Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty.
- Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries.

Useful experience, but not required

- DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems.
- Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems.
- GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems.
- Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing.
- Experience supporting analytics, AI/ML, feature-store-style access patterns, or cross-domain product-service integrations.
- Experience with JVM languages and Python, TypeScript, Go, or Ruby.

What we offer you

At Smartly, we offer a place where you can do meaningful technical work while growing with a global team.

- Inclusive global culture built on trust, transparency, open feedback, and respect for different perspectives.
- Global impact through technology used by major brands to plan, create, optimize, and understand digital advertising at scale.
- Wellbeing support, paid holidays, family leave, and sustainable ways of working.
- Equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities.
- A flexible hybrid workplace that balances office collaboration with focused remote work. At Smartly we work 3 days a week from the office.

About Smartly

Smartly is an advertising technology company helping brands create, manage, optimize, and understand digital advertising across major media platforms. Our engineering organization builds the systems that connect media, creative, and intelligence capabilities into a product used by customers globally.

We value clear communication, ownership, curiosity, and collaboration across teams. We want Smartly to be a place where people can do strong work, grow, and feel respected.

Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway. We care about strong engineering fundamentals, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to build reliable systems with others. Direct experience with every technology listed here is less important than the judgment to learn, reason from first principles, and ship useful platform capabilities.

About Smartly

Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.

Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. jobs.description:
Would you like to own driving revenue and customer engagements for a leader in the Cloud Computing business? Would you like to be part of a team focused on increasing awareness and adoption of Amazon Web Services by engaging with Public Sector organizations in Germany who are reinventing their IT strategy by adopting cloud computing? Do you have the business savvy, sales experience, and technical background necessary to help further establish Amazon as a leading cloud platform provider?

As a Greenfield Account Executive within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Worldwide Public Sector (WWPS), you will build AWS adoption in net-new public sector accounts with limited or no existing AWS presence. You will own the full sales cycle, from prospecting through close, helping public sector organizations reinvent their IT strategy through cloud computing.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in full sales cycle, technology sales, sales engineering/consulting or equivalent business development
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience
- Experience using sales CRM tools such as Salesforce
- Fluent in German and English with the ability to conduct sales and technical conversations with customers in both languages
- Experience developing and executing sales strategies, tactics, plans, processes, systems and programs
- Experience in generating new opportunities with strong focus on pipeline tracking and deal execution through entire sales cycle

Preferred qualifications

- AWS Associate level certification, or Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
- Experience with government procurement and contracting process
- Experience working with partners through account, product or program management and business development engagements
- Experience selling nascent products and services Ability to drive solutions to difficult problems
- Experience driving new business in greenfield accounts at the C-suite level or equivalent
- Experience in strategic thinking about business, enterprise software products, and new technology platforms and architectures or equivalent

This role requires building a sales function from the ground up, demanding creative problem-solving, tenacity, and the ability to develop novel approaches for reaching and engaging prospective customers. You will establish business and technical relationships with public sector organizations, driving adoption of AWS services that transform how they deliver services to citizens and communities.

You will engage customers face-to-face and via teleconference, interacting at the CXO level in strategic accounts. The ideal candidate possesses both business acumen to drive executive-level engagements and technical knowledge to interact effectively with software developers and architects.

This position requires working from the local office when not at customer sites.

Key job responsibilities
Sales Execution
• Prospect and qualify net-new public sector accounts with limited or no AWS presence
• Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through close
• Meet or exceed quarterly revenue targets while maintaining robust pipeline coverage
• Maintain accurate sales forecasts and pipeline reporting in Salesforce

Customer Engagement
• Develop and execute territory plans to maximize market penetration
• Translate cloud and AI capabilities into mission-relevant use cases for public sector organizations
• Build relationships across customer organizations, including C-level executives, engineering, IT/operations, and procurement
• Conduct discovery calls to understand agency missions and technical challenges

Public Sector Expertise
• Navigate public sector procurement processes including RFPs, cooperative contracts, and federal/state/local contract vehicles
• Apply knowledge of public sector compliance requirements, certifications, and fiscal year buying cycles
• Structure deals that meet public sector regulatory, compliance, and grant-funded operating requirements

Collaboration
• Partner with solutions architects and internal stakeholders to accelerate deal velocity
• Collaborate with the partner ecosystem (systems integrators, resellers, distributors) to drive customer success and extend market reach
• Use data and insights to prioritize outreach and identify high-potential prospects

A day in the life

jobs.occupation: Staff Network Reliability Engineer (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Informations-, Kommunikationstechnik)
jobs.description:
NRE Operations runs the data center networks for the entire IONOS group: the physical fabric and underlay, the SDN overlay, and the virtual network functions on top, across dozens of data centers. We are looking for a senior or staff-level engineer who operates large production networks with a reliability mindset. You define what "healthy" means, catch problems before customers do, lead the hardest incidents, and partner with NRE Automation to push routine operations toward zero manual steps. AI is central to how we work, both to make the network smarter and to make each engineer faster.

We expect every engineer here to be fluent with AI, and we mean it in two concrete ways. First, applying AI to the network itself: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis and root-cause analysis, config generation and validation, smarter alerting, and runbook or agent-driven automation. Second, using AI to raise your own output: coding assistants and LLM tooling for scripting, troubleshooting, research, and documentation. Reliability work punishes blind trust, so the skill that matters most is judgment. You need to know when an AI-generated config or diagnosis is trustworthy and when it is not.

Tasks

- Own reliability of the physical fabric, SDN overlay, and virtual network functions across all IONOS data centers. Set service level objectives and drive down unplanned downtime.
- Lead incident response on major network incidents and run postmortems that produce lasting fixes.
- Remove toil through automation, working with NRE Automation on pipelines and tooling for lifecycle, patching, and service configuration.
- Apply AI to operations: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis, config generation and validation, and automated remediation, with the judgment to know when AI output is trustworthy.
- Strengthen observability so problems surface before they reach customers, and shape lifecycle, upgrade, change-management, and capacity practices.
- Collaborate with NRE Provisioning on clean handovers.
- Share the on-call rotation covering the above.

Qualifications

- Extensive hands-on experience operating large-scale production data center networks (5+ years for Senior, longer for Staff).
- Deep Layer 2 and Layer 3 knowledge: routing (BGP, OSPF) and VXLAN with BGP/EVPN.
- Multi-vendor operations across Juniper and Cisco; SONiC and Netbox familiarity is a plus.
- Strong Linux fundamentals and the toolkit that goes with them (bash, tcpdump, iptables, git).
- Network automation you have built, using Python with Ansible and CI/CD on GitLab.
- A reliability-engineering mindset: SLOs, observability, incident command, postmortems, designing out toil.
- Fluent, critical use of AI in daily engineering, plus a track record or credible ideas for applying AI to network operations.
- Fluent English for international teams; German is a plus. Ownership and a calm approach when things break.

Benefits

- Hybrid working model.
- Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.
- At some locations a subsidized canteen and various free drinks.
- Modern office space with very good transport connections.
- Various employee discounts for activities and products.
- Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.
- Numerous training and development opportunities.
- Various health offers, such as sports and health courses.

jobs.occupation: vEFK - Verantwortliche Elektrofachkraft / Qualified Electrician (m/f/d) (Elektrofachkraft für festgelegte Tätigkeiten)
jobs.description:
TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

We are seeking an experienced **vEFK (Electrical Safety Manager)** to take on formal electrical safety responsibility for our drone production facility, in accordance with DGUV Vorschrift 3 and DIN VDE 0105-100. As vEFK, you will be the designated person accountable for the safe operation, maintenance, and modification of all electrical systems and equipment across production lines, test benches, and facility infrastructure.

Your Road Map To Make an Impact

- Assume formal responsibility (per §13 DGUV V3 / VDE 0105) for electrical safety across the production facility, including assembly lines, battery test/charging stations, RF and avionics test benches, and building electrical systems
- Issue, review, and sign off on electrical work permits and switching authorizations
- Conduct and document risk assessments for electrical work (live working, lockout/tagout, isolation procedures)
- Supervise and coordinate Elektrofachkräfte (EFK) and elektrotechnisch unterwiesene Personen (EuP) on site
- Oversee inspection and testing of electrical equipment, machinery, and battery/charging infrastructure (per DGUV V3, VDE 0701-0702, and applicable Li-ion battery handling standards)
- Manage compliance with low-voltage directive, EMC requirements, and relevant drone/UAV manufacturing electrical safety standards
- Investigate electrical incidents, near-misses, and non-conformances; drive corrective actions
- Maintain documentation: circuit diagrams, inspection logs, training records, and safety instructions (Betriebsanweisungen)
- Liaise with quality, EHS, and engineering teams on electrical aspects of new production line rollouts and equipment procurement
- Train and qualify personnel on electrical safety procedures specific to drone assembly (e.g., high-density battery packs, motor/ESC testing, RF equipment)

Job requirements

- Completed vocational/technical training as Elektroniker, Elektroinstallateur, or equivalent, plus further qualification enabling appointment as vEFK (e.g., Meister, Techniker, or Ingenieur in Elektrotechnik)
- Formal written appointment eligibility as vEFK per employer's organizational delegation (Unternehmerpflichtenübertragung)
- Several years of hands-on experience in industrial electrical systems, ideally in manufacturing/production environments
- Sound knowledge of DGUV Vorschrift 3, VDE 0100/0105, VDE 0701-0702, and low-voltage directive requirements
- Experience with battery systems (Li-Po/Li-ion) and their associated electrical hazards is highly desirable given the UAV/drone context
- Strong documentation discipline and ability to train/supervise other electrical personnel
- Fluent German (technical/regulatory) and good working English (for international engineering teams)

Preferred / Nice to Have

- Experience in aerospace, UAV, or electronics/precision manufacturing
- Familiarity with ESD-sensitive component handling
- Knowledge of RF/EMC testing environments
- Experience with automated or semi-automated production line electrical systems

Why TYTAN?

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security
- Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale
- Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors
- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback
- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact
- Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company
- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation
- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit
- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us
- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team
- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together
- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands
- Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

jobs.occupation: (Junior) Data Scientist (m/f/d) Search / AI Forge (Data Scientist)
jobs.description:
Über diesen Job:
CHECK24 is the comparison portal: We are both the market leader and a dynamic startup. Working in agile teams, we make fast decisions and embrace flat hierarchies. By leveraging the latest tools and technologies as well as state-of-the-art AI methods, we drive data-driven innovation – always focusing on creating added value for our customers. Across more than 50 products, we work every day to continuously improve the user experience of our more than 20 million customers.
Our Search Team within CHECK24 AI Forge develops scalable AI solutions for search and ranking across different CHECK24 products. Search is a crucial entry and navigation point for our customers and covers challenging domains ranging from e-commerce product search and web-style navigation to travel search for hotels, destinations and other products.
Search and Ranking are among the most demanding disciplines in applied machine learning. A successful system needs to understand user intent, retrieve relevant candidates, rank them effectively and meet demanding requirements for latency, scalability and measurable customer impact.
To strengthen our team, we are looking for someone with first relevant hands-on experience who is eager to grow into a strong Applied Machine Learning Engineer. In this role, you will work on production systems combining classical information retrieval, deep learning, embeddings and Large Language Models and contribute across the entire lifecycle from initial idea and evaluation to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.
We look forward to receiving your application as a (Junior) Data Scientist (m/f/d) Search at CHECK24 AI Forge GmbH.

Was Du mitbringst:

- You have successfully completed a degree (typically a Master's) in computer science, mathematics, statistics, physics, electrical engineering or a comparable quantitative field, with strong grades in quantitative subjects
- At least one year of relevant hands-on experience in machine learning or data science is part of your background, including relevant experience gained through working-student positions, internships or your own projects
- Strong Python skills and practical experience with machine-learning or deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch are part of your technical toolkit
- Solid classical machine-learning skills like gradient boosting, regression and feature engineering are evident in your CV, beyond LLM or RAG applications
- You have practical experience with applications based on Large Language Models, LLM evaluation, tool use or agentic workflows
- A solid understanding of machine-learning fundamentals and systematic model evaluation enables you to assess and improve model performance
- Practical experience with APIs (e.g. FastAPI), containers and Git, ideally a deployed service, complements your interest in building complete production services
- Knowledge of information retrieval, semantic search, recommender systems or learning-to-rank approaches is a plus
- You have English proficiency at C1 level or higher; German is a plus but not required

Zu Deinen Aufgaben zählen:

- You develop and improve machine-learning services for retrieval, ranking, query understanding and classification
- Hybrid search solutions combine lexical retrieval, embeddings, neural models and components based on Large Language Models
- Model development covers training, fine-tuning and systematic evaluation for semantic search, relevance prediction and learning-to-rank use cases
- You create reliable evaluation datasets and metrics and validate improvements through offline evaluations, user signals and A/B tests
- Production-ready services are built from prototypes using technologies such as Python, FastAPI, Docker, PyTorch and vector databases
- Modern AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows enable efficient prototyping, testing and continuous improvement
- You research promising approaches in information retrieval, recommender systems and Large Language Models and translate them into measurable customer impact

Was wir Dir bieten:
Development and responsibility

- Your commitment pays off – we support your talent and provide opportunities to grow your career quickly
- Take ownership of your topics, contribute your own ideas, try new approaches and gradually assume responsibility for production Search and Ranking systems
- Benefit from internal training with specialized coaches as well as an annual budget for external professional development
Team spirit and modern workspace
- Experience team spirit in your daily work and beyond, whether over lunch, a game of table football or after-work activities, and celebrate our successes at regular company and team events
- Work in an inspiring environment with a modern office and high-quality equipment such as MacBooks and height-adjustable desks
Flexibility and balance
- Fridays are home-office optional – and spending them in the office can earn you additional vacation days on top of your 28 days
- Get to the office conveniently with your free Deutschlandticket or a subsidized company bicycle
- Enjoy a free fresh lunch twice a week and use the opportunity to connect with your colleagues
- Stay active with our internal sports classes or take advantage of our subsidized external sports offering, including EGYM Wellpass

- Very good written and spoken English and good knowledge of German

jobs.description:
What to Expect

The Tesla EMEA Indirect Procurement team is looking for a highly motivated Supply Chain Manager to support procurement for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment across the broader EMEA region. You will partner closely with Engineering, Facilities, Finance, and operations stakeholders to source and manage complex service, supplies and equipment spend — from engineering consultancies, test and lab services, and specialized technical support through to engineering equipment, tooling, and infrastructure investments. This role requires a hands-on buyer who can drive end-to-end sourcing, negotiate commercial terms, ensure compliant purchase-to-pay execution, and keep critical engineering and capital programs on schedule and on budget.

What You’ll Do

- Serve as the primary Indirect Procurement partner for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment demand across EMEA, translating business requirements into clear scopes of work, sourcing strategies, and executable purchase packages.
- Lead end-to-end sourcing for engineering services (e.g., design/engineering support, testing, prototyping services, technical consultancy, and specialized lab/operations support) and engineering supplies (e.g., lab consumables, non-production hardware, development materials) and equipment categories (tooling, fixtures, facility and infrastructure investments).
- Own RFx processes (RFI/RFP/RFQ): develop bid packages, run competitive tenders, evaluate commercial and technical proposals, and present award recommendations that balance cost, lead time, quality, risk, and supplier capability.
- Dive deep into supplier quotes and statements of work to challenge scope, pricing structures, rates, milestones, and total cost of ownership; negotiate best cost, payment terms, warranties, SLAs, and commercial protections.
- Ensure supply activation and on-time delivery for engineering development activities and capital projects, proactively managing bottlenecks, change orders, and expedites.
- Partner with Engineering, Facilities, Finance/FP&A, Legal, and Compliance to align budgets, approval thresholds, contract terms, and capital equipment spend governance requirements.
- Manage the full purchase-to-pay lifecycle for assigned categories: requisition triage, PO creation/release, goods receipt / service confirmation support, invoice issue resolution, and spend compliance.
- Build and maintain a capable regional supplier base for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment across EMEA; drive preferred-supplier strategies, framework agreements, and multi-site leverage where beneficial.
- Track category spend, savings, cost avoidance, and risk; report status, escalations, and opportunities to Supply Chain leadership and key stakeholders.
- Work collaboratively at a cross-functional level with Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Supplier Industrialization, Legal, Finance, and other Supply Chain teams to deliver seamless operational support.
- Uphold Tesla procurement policies, ethical standards, and audit readiness across all sourcing and contracting activities.

What You’ll Bring

- You live and breathe procurement. You take ownership of assigned buying demand and ensure Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment needs stay in control from intake through delivery and payment.
- You possess a higher vocational or university qualification in a subject such as automotive engineering, mechanical engineering or business management, or equivalent experience
- Specific diploma’s Supply Chain/Purchasing are preferred
- Proven 5+ years of experience in Indirect Procurement, with hands-on ownership of Engineering Services and/or engineering equipment categories (equipment, tooling, technical services, project-related spend).
- Experience supporting manufacturing, automotive, industrial, or high-tech engineering environments is preferred; familiarity with plant/lab operations at a gigafactory or similar large industrial site is a plus.
- Strong commercial acumen: able to interpret complex SOWs, rate cards, and multi-year service proposals and negotiate cost, terms, and risk allocation.
- Comfortable operating across multiple sites and stakeholders across Tesla operations specifically in the wider EMEA region; experience with cross-border sourcing and multi-currency contracting is advantageous.
- Working knowledge of P2P / ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, or equivalent) and standard procurement governance (DOA, capital expenditure approval flows, contract lifecycle).
- Analytical, structured, and hands-on — equally effective running a strategic tender and resolving day-to-day PO, delivery, or invoice issues.
- Exceptional stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills; ability to lead high-stakes contract discussions, challenge constructively and drive decisions at pace.
- You are fluent in English; German language skills are a strong plus.

The Director, Sales Operations — DACH is a senior leadership role responsible for the operational effectiveness, productivity, and go-to-market efficiency of Mitel's sales organization across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. The role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, partnering directly with DACH Sales Leadership to drive performance through world-class processes, data-driven insight, and operational rigor.

Reporting to the Group Director, Sales Operations International, the Director will lead a dedicated DACH Sales Operations team and work in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Finance, HR, Marketing, IT, and the global Revenue Operations function. This is a high-visibility role with direct impact on revenue, growth, and organizational effectiveness across one of Mitel's most strategically important regions.

Job Responsibilities

1. Sales Planning, Forecasting & Quota Management

- Lead sales forecasting, planning, and budgeting processes across the DACH region, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment with global Revenue Operations standards
- Design and own the equitable allocation of sales quotas across all DACH channels and resources, ensuring every team member is set up to succeed and all objectives are assigned on time

- Attend and actively contribute to ELT forecast reviews, bi-weekly regional forecast reviews, and Close the Gap sessions, providing data-driven analysis and actionable recommendations
- Responsible for theatre communications within the DACH sales organisation on process, programmes, and initiatives

2. Go-to-Market Coverage & Territory Optimisation

- Design and optimise go-to-market coverage models across the DACH region, ensuring the right sales resources are deployed against the highest-value market opportunities
- Lead account segmentation initiatives — analysing firmographic, revenue, and growth-potential data to classify accounts and align them to the most effective sales motions
- Own sales representative and channel assignment frameworks, balancing workload, market potential, and specialisation to maximise revenue per head and overall regional ROI
- Partner with Sales Leadership and Finance to model territory design scenarios, simulate revenue impact, and make data-driven recommendations on coverage changes
- Continuously monitor coverage efficiency metrics including whitespace analysis, account penetration rates, and capacity utilisation to identify and act on growth opportunities

3. Channel Integrity & Direct/Partner Segregation

- Define, document, and enforce clear rules of engagement between Mitel's direct sales force and channel partners, ensuring unambiguous account ownership and minimising conflict across DACH
- Own and maintain the account segmentation framework that determines which accounts are served direct versus through channel, based on criteria including account size, strategic value, geography, and partner capability
- Establish and govern escalation and arbitration processes for channel conflict, acting as the neutral arbiter when direct and partner routes overlap or compete for the same opportunity
- Work with Sales Leadership and Channel Management to implement systematic account tagging and CRM controls that enforce segregation policies and provide full visibility into coverage boundaries
- Conduct regular audits of direct and partner account assignments to detect and resolve boundary violations, ensuring compliance with Mitel's channel programme terms
- Partner with Legal, Finance, and Channel Programme teams to ensure compensation and incentive structures reinforce the segregation between direct and indirect sales motions

4. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

- Proactively identify and eliminate bottlenecks in the sales process, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational rigour across DACH
- Lead process definition and documentation for DACH Sales Operations, including approval policies, PreSales workflows, and Service processes — developing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and ensuring cross-functional alignment
- Facilitate cross-departmental workshops to define, align, and continuously improve Sales Operations processes in collaboration with Finance, Legal, HR, and IT
- Working with Sales Leaders and Marketing, implement internal sales SPIFFs and Partner Rewards programmes, managing the delivery tools
- Own and deliver process training programmes for Sales, PreSales, and Sales Management teams across DACH — preparing materials, conducting sessions, and monitoring adoption

5. Technology, Reporting & Business Intelligence

- Own the deployment and optimisation of enabling technologies including CRM across the DACH region — ensuring data integrity, compliance with global standards, and maximum ROI from Mitel's technology investments
- Monitor the accuracy and efficient distribution of sales reports and intelligence essential to the DACH sales organisation; recommend revisions to existing reports or develop new reporting tools as needed
- Build and maintain a suite of dashboards and reports that give DACH Sales Leadership the intelligence needed to make fast, well-informed decisions
- Participate in DACH Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) calls, providing Sales data and CRM insights to inform supply chain and inventory planning
- Coordinate CRM data and process alignment with the DACH Marketing team to support campaign execution, pipeline generation, and lead management

6. Deal Desk Oversight & Bid Approval Management

- Provide leadership and strategic oversight of the DACH Sales Deal Desk — ensuring accurate Named Account checks, partner certification verification, competitive analysis, and deal matrix generation for the indirect channel pipeline
- Govern the Bid Approval Management process for the DACH region, overseeing Executive Deal Reviews (Level 1), coordinating approvals in Salesforce, and maintaining thorough documentation and filing of all bid decisions
- Define and continuously refine Deal Desk processes and rules of engagement, managing escalations and ensuring cooperation between direct sales, channel teams, and deal desk resources
- Conduct Named Account list reviews on a regular basis, ensuring accurate maintenance and alignment with agreed direct/indirect coverage boundaries

7. Sales Incentive Compensation

- Provide input to senior leadership in the development and administration of sales incentive compensation programmes for the DACH region
- Working with Finance, HR, and the global Revenue Operations team, provide assistance with sales incentive compensation administration — including arbitration and clarification of compensation policy application
- Ensure compensation and incentive structures are aligned to reinforce go-to-market strategy and channel segregation objectives

8. Governance, Management Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Support the DACH leadership team in Risk Control Board activities, audit processes, and governance obligations — acting as the Sales Operations representative in regional management forums
- Act as a key liaison between DACH Sales management and global Revenue Operations/Sales Operations leadership, ensuring regional priorities are well represented and global programmes are effectively localised
- Partner with the Service organisation on sales campaign coordination and deliver ad-hoc CRM-based sales reports to support Service planning activities
- Direct and support the consistent implementation of company initiatives across the DACH sales organisation
- Build peer support and strong internal relationships with key management personnel across Finance, Marketing, HR, Legal, and IT

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution, or equivalent professional experience (5+ years in B2B sales, sales operations, or sales management)
- Proven track record leading analytically complex Sales Operations or Revenue Operations initiatives with demonstrable business impact
- Deep expertise in CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred), sales analytics, and operational tooling
- Strong experience in quota design, territory modelling, and go-to-market coverage optimisation
- Experience managing or overseeing formal bid and deal approval processes in an enterprise B2B environment
- Demonstrated ability to manage channel partner relationships and enforce rules of engagement in a direct/indirect sales model
- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills — able to influence and present confidently at all organisational levels
- Deep understanding of the DACH business landscape, commercial culture, and regulatory environment
- Fluency in German and English (written and spoken) — additional language skills in French or Italian are a plus

jobs.description:
What to Expect

The EMEA Infrastructure Development team is seeking a Senior Cost Estimator to serve as the subject matter expert in construction cost estimating across Tesla's EMEA portfolio, including Service Centers, Retail Stores, Delivery Hubs, and Non-SSD sites (R&D, Training, Offices, etc.) You will drive the transition from decentralized regional estimating to a centralized EMEA-wide approach — defining the methodology, standards, templates, and governance for how projects are evaluated. You will deliver independent, reliable construction cost estimates at every project stage, giving project teams, designers, procurement, and leadership a trusted reference for go/no-go decisions.

What You’ll Do

- Develop cost estimates from Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) through detailed CapEx budgets, with accuracy appropriate to each project stage (AACE estimate classes as reference framework)
- Produce high-level estimates based on historic data to support go/no-go decisions against key cost metrics
- Analyze plans, Due diligence reports and interpret designs; perform dimensional quantity take-offs; identify scope implied but not explicitly shown in design documents
- Develop and manage a Basis of Estimate for each project — scope, execution strategy, precision level, assumptions, exclusions, risks, and critical information
- Lead value engineering at early design stages, providing cost-driven feedback and recommendations to designers
- Visit project sites as required to validate scope, site conditions, and constraints in support of estimation — working from assumptions and scope definition provided by the Project Manager, Real Estate team and design team
- Support the Procurement and PMs with contractor pricing validation and bid leveling to ensure we are receiving good value for spends
- Contribute to continuous improvement of estimating processes
- Maintain and update the cost database, ensuring pricing reflects current market conditions, inflation, transport costs, and regional differentiation
- Deliver accurate, independently validated estimates to support ATP and go/no-go decisions; review outputs against historic pricing and regional benchmarks
- Provide expert input to Procurement on sourcing and pricing for atypical works or high cost-variance items

What You’ll Bring

- Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, or related field — or equivalent professional experience
- 5+ years as a senior specialist or SME in project cost estimating, preferably in retail, commercial, industrial, or multi-site infrastructure rollout environments
- Practical knowledge of construction means and methods across civil, structural, architectural, MEP disciplines with the ability to translate technical knowledge into accurate, defensible cost advice
- Solid understanding of CapEx cost estimating from ROM through detailed CapEx budgeting; proven experience with quantity take-offs and design document interpretation
- Experience maintaining or developing pricing databases or cost libraries at a portfolio or multi-country level
- Ability of identifying main risks especially during ROM which could significantly impact the costs in a later stage
- Analytical, detail-oriented, and self-motivated; proactive communicator in a fast-paced, multicultural environment
- Experience building, leading, or transitioning to a centralized estimating function — methodology, SOPs, and standardization frameworks
- Proven track record as the go-to cost expert for project teams, designers, and leadership; authoritative cost advice with confidence, independence, and sound professional judgement
- Availability to travel across EMEA as required (up to 50%)
- English required; additional European language skills a strong plus
