jobs.employer_name: Leibniz-Institut für Agrartechnik und Bioökonomie e.V.
jobs.description:
The Leibniz Institute for Agricultural Engineering and Bioeconomy (ATB) is a pioneer and a driver of bioeconomy research. We create the scientific foundation to transform agricultural, food, industrial and energy systems into a sustainable bio-based circular economy. We develop and integrate techniques, processes and management strategies, effectively converging technologies to intelligently crosslink highly diverse bioeconomic production systems and to control them in a knowledge-based, adaptive and largely automated manner. We conduct research in dialogue with society, policymakers, industry and other stakeholders - knowledge-driven and application-inspired.

To support Economics of Technologies in Agriculture in the Technology Assessment Department we are seeking, at the earliest possible date a

Doctoral researcher (m/f/d) (75 %)

for the research area

„Economic analysis of innovative fenland use“

The economic analysis includes various lines of utilization of biomass from wet fenland sites and analysis of greenhouse gas abatement potentials resulting from the change in land use. Cost analysis includes approaches and cost estimates for planning, permission, management, and harvest of mixed vegetation, storage and transportation, and processing in innovative biomass utilization pathways. Labor times, costs, and potential savings from autonomous harvesting vehicles, among others, are identified. Reference uses and innovative business models are also considered to determine the economic viability of specific processes.

The aim of the project is to create a network of model and demonstration projects for the use of rewetted fens with representative fen areas, biomass utilization pathways and relevant actors in Brandenburg. Partners are in addition to ATB the Brandenburg State Office for the Environment (LfU), the University for Sustainable Development Eberswalde (HNEE), the Leibniz Centre for Agricultural Landscape Research (ZALF) and the Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences (GFZ). The WetNetBB network is part of a network of model and demonstration projects (PaludiNet) coordinated by the Thünen Institute (TI) and Greifswald Moor Centrum (GMC) as PaludiCenter. The position is assigned to the Technology Assessment Department at the ATB, and close cooperation with the Systems Process Engineering Department is intended. 

Yourtasks

- Development of models for calculating the economic potential of different utilization systems on wet fenlands
- Recording and analysis of the labour time requirements of novel forms of use of wet fenlands
- Quantitative and qualitative evaluation of scientific results
- Development of scenario-based calculations of the costs of agricultural use through paludiculture on lowland bog sites
- Presentation of project results at scientific conferences and stakeholder meetings
- Writing of scientific publications and project reports

Your qualifications

- Very good university degree in agricultural economics or related subjects (Diploma or Master of Science)
- Knowledge and experience in economic analysis of agricultural systems
- Knowledge in statistical data analysis
- Strong interest in interdisciplinary collaboration
- Very good knowledge of written and spoken English
- Very good knowledge of German for communication with stakeholders and farmers
- Ability to work in a team and willingness to cooperate, reliability, flexibility, personal commitment and independent working skills
- EU driving license class B desirable

We offer

- Encouragement and support for PhD candidates in pursuing their doctoral studies in collaboration with partner universities
- An attractive, research-intensive, and interdisciplinary working environment
- A varied position at the interface of science and practice
- Excellent infrastructure for scientific work
- Access to national and international networks for your scientific development
- Training and further education opportunities
- Family-friendly working conditions to promote work-life balance
- Participation in the VBB company ticket or Deutschlandticket
- A workplace at the edge of a picturesque landscape, easily accessible by bike or public transport

The part-time position (30 hours/week) is initially limited to 4 years. Salary will be based on your qualifications and experience according to TV-L up to pay grade E 13.

For further information, please contact Dr. Andreas Meyer-Aurich (phone +49 331 5699-222) and visit our website at www.atb-potsdam.de (http://www.atb-potsdam.de) .

Have we piqued your interest? Then apply by 30 September 2026 with your cover letter, CV (without photo), and employment references and/or contact details of referees via our online application portal for this job posting (reference number 2026-TA-3) at www.atb-potsdam.de/en/career/vacancies (http://www.atb-potsdam.de/en/career/vacancies) . 

As a certified family-friendly institute, the ATB is committed to equal opportunities and diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnic or social background, age, religion, disability, or sexual identity. Applications from people with severe disabilities are particularly encouraged and will be given preference in the event of equal qualifications.

The ATB aims to increase the proportion of women among doctoral researchers and therefore explicitly encourages applications from women.

By submitting your application, you agree that your documents may be stored for up to six months even in the case of an unsuccessful application. Further information on data protection can be found here:
www.atb-potsdam.de/en/data-protection-declaration-for-the-application-process (http://www.atb-potsdam.de/en/data-protection-declaration-for-the-application-process) .

As an SAP S/4HANA Consultant (f/m/d), you will support the global Finance Key User Community throughout SAP S/4HANA rollouts and the transition into business operations. Acting as the bridge between Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and IT, you will challenge business requirements, drive fit-to-standard solutions, and ensure sustainable processes aligned with the global S/4HANA template.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Advise business stakeholders on standard SAP S/4HANA processes and fit-to-standard solutions
* Analyze, challenge, and document business requirements across end-to-end finance processes
* Identify template gaps and drive continuous improvements aligned with the global rollout strategy
* Support PMO activities during ongoing S/4HANA rollout projects and business transitions
* Collaborate with Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and IT to ensure integrated end-to-end processes
* Translate business needs into SAP system logic and enable standardized, scalable solutions

What You Bring

* Degree in Finance, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field
* Significant expertise in SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) within global rollout environments
* Strong understanding of COGS flows, variance analysis, transfer pricing, and intercompany processes
* Experience with project-based manufacturing, engineering-driven businesses, and Group Reporting structures
* Proven ability to challenge business requirements and drive standardization across cross-functional teams
* Business fluent English; German is a plus

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Technology Transfer & Partnership Manager – Applied Geodata & Research Solutions (Full-Time / m/f/d) (Master of Business Administration)
jobs.description:
Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available) 

Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent / Dual Master Track available) 

Target Group: Business Development Managers, Technology Transfer Specialists, Marketing & Sales Talents, Master’s Graduates, Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) Holders 

About Project Iris 

Project Iris is an applied research initiative dedicated to automated spatial data analysis, land registry intelligence, sustainable infrastructure mapping, and open-source resilience modeling. 

To ensure long-term independence and funding for non-profit research, Project Iris works with an established commercial transfer network (including RE-Managers GmbH). Through this framework, proprietary data algorithms, geospatial scoring models, and automation tools are licensed and deployed across real-world commercial sectors (e.g., real estate, institutional investments, infrastructure providers, and SME enterprise solutions). 

Your Focus & Responsibilities 

- Research Transfer & Commercialization: Identify commercial use cases for our geospatial and resilience data models, translating scientific capabilities into clear value propositions for enterprise clients and institutional partners. 
- B2B Outreach & Pipeline Management: Lead proactive outreach campaigns targeting potential data partners, municipalities, enterprise clients, and specialized service providers using modern CRM and automation tools (e.g., Odoo ERP, automated email workflows). 
- Partner Onboarding & Account Management: Manage communication with corporate partners, coordinate pilot testing phases, and gather operational market feedback to help researchers refine underlying data models. 
- Marketing & Value Proposition Communication: Create structured presentation decks, use-case briefs, and digital campaign materials to position our data products in commercial and public markets. 
- Funding & Grant Alignment: Support the interface between commercial data licensing and applied research funding projects. 

What We Are Looking For 

- Educational Background: Degree in Business Administration, Technology Management, International Business, Marketing, Geoinformatics, Economics, or a related field. 
- Professional Competencies: 
- Strong interest in technology, spatial data, AI platforms, or digital business models. 
- Experience with or quick adoption of digital outreach tools, CRM systems (e.g., Odoo), and structured email communication. 
- High level of communication clarity, commercial acumen, and consultative relationship-building skills. 
- Mindset: Proactive, structured, and comfortable working at the intersection of non-profit research and commercial markets. 
- Eligibility: Open to local and international applicants currently in Germany (e.g., Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card, Job-Seeker Visa, EU Work Permit). 
- Languages: Excellent working proficiency in English (required); good command of German is a strong advantage for the DACH market. 

What We Offer 

- Full-Time Permanent Position: Long-term career security with direct exposure to executive management and commercial leadership. 
- Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: We support continuous academic development through fully sponsored Master Trainee and Dual Master tracks. 
- Accommodation & Onboarding Support: Concrete assistance with local housing search, official registration, and structured onboarding. 
- Visa & Relocation Assistance: Comprehensive employer backing for German Opportunity Card conversions and residence permit processes. 
- Direct Business Impact: Drive the commercial sustainability of high-impact research projects without corporate bureaucracy. 

How to Apply 

Send your CV, references, and your earliest possible start date to: 

E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.de

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer – Applied AI, Geodata Systems & Data Transfer (Full-Time / m/f/d) (Geoinformatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available) 

Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent) 

Target Group: Software Engineers, Data Engineers, Full-Stack Developers, Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) Holders, and Master’s Graduates 

About Project Iris 

Project Iris is an applied research and technology initiative dedicated to automated spatial data analysis, cadastre intelligence, infrastructure mapping, and open-source data modeling. 

Together with our commercial transfer network (including RE-Managers GmbH), we bridge the gap between academic data science, resilience research, and practical real-world application. Complex geospatial and resilience data models are deployed into active enterprise environments, stakeholder portals, and infrastructure tools. The resulting real-world usage and performance metrics are continuously validated and fed back into our open research models. 

In this role, you turn algorithmic frameworks and spatial datasets into robust, production-ready digital architectures. 

Your Focus & Responsibilities 

- Geospatial & Core Data Modeling: Develop and refine automated pipelines for spatial datasets, open-source cadastre records, and environmental scoring algorithms using Python. 
- AI-Assisted Full-Stack Integration: Transform algorithmic logic into high-performance FastAPI backends and connect them with modern React/Next.js frontends (leveraging cutting-edge tools such as v0.dev, Cursor, and Windsurf). 
- Applied Transfer & Enterprise Workflows: Implement real-world pilot applications by connecting data models to practical workflows (e.g., automated property screening, municipal portals, and ERP/Odoo interface connections for infrastructure). 
- Multi-Tenant Architecture & Cloud Deployment: Package services into robust Docker multi-container environments and deploy them on secure European/Swiss server infrastructure (Infomaniak VPS) with strict Row-Level Security (RLS) and data privacy standards. 
- Continuous Feedback Architecture: Establish data pipelines that capture operational feedback from commercial deployments to refine and advance the research models. 

What We Are Looking For 

- Technical Background: Degree in Computer Science, Geoinformatics, Software Engineering, Data Science, or equivalent practical industry experience. 
- Core Technical Skills: 
- Solid programming foundation in Python (FastAPI, Pandas, data handling) and/or modern Web technologies (TypeScript, React, Next.js). 
- Working knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL) and containerization (Docker / Docker Compose). 
- Practical experience or strong interest in AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, v0.dev, LLM APIs). 
- Mindset: Strong analytical curiosity, proactive problem-solving attitude, and a clean-code engineering approach. 
- Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates currently in Germany (e.g., Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card, Job-Seeker Visa, or EU Work Permit). 
- Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); German language skills are a plus. 

What We Offer 

- Full-Time Permanent Employment: Long-term career stability with clear growth trajectories into Senior Engineering or Technical Leadership roles. 
- Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: For candidates looking to combine full-time practice with further academic credentials, we offer tailored Master Trainee tracks including academic coordination and complete tuition support. 
- Accommodation & Onboarding Package: Structured assistance with local accommodation, official registration, and comprehensive onboarding support. 
- Visa & Administrative Backing: Dedicated employer support for Opportunity Card conversions and German residence/work permit applications. 
- Modern AI-First Work Environment: Work in a high-efficiency environment where repetitive boilerplate code is automated, allowing you to focus on high-value architecture, data logic, and deployment. 
- Direct Mentorship: Close collaboration with experienced technical architects and executive leadership. 

How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.de  

(Subject: Application – Software Engineer Applied AI & Geodata)

jobs.employer_name: Leibniz-Institut für Agrartechnik und Bioökonomie e.V.
jobs.description:
The Leibniz Institute for Agricultural Engineering and Bioeconomy (ATB) is a pioneer and a driver of bioeconomy research. We create the scientific foundation to transform agricultural, food, industrial and energy systems into a sustainable bio-based circular economy. We develop and integrate techniques, processes and management strategies, effectively converging technologies to intelligently crosslink highly diverse bioeconomic production systems and to control them in a knowledge-based, adaptive and largely automated manner. We conduct research in dialogue with society, policymakers, industry and other stakeholders - knowledge-driven and application-inspired.

As part of the HORIZON project ‘Towards scalable monitoring, reporting, verification and mitigation of non-CO2 greenhouse gas and ammonia emissions from land-based agricultural systems (MARVELA)’, we are looking, subject to funding approval, for a

Scientist (PostDoc) (m/f/d) (100 %)

for the task area 

Development and validation of IoT-based sensor systems for environmental monitoring

Within the MARVELA project, innovative, cost-effective and user-friendly measurement systems for the continuous monitoring of greenhouse gases, ammonia and relevant environmental parameters at farm level will be developed, optimized and validated. At ATB, the work focuses on the further development of modular IoT-based sensor systems, the integration of sensors, embedded electronics and communication interfaces, and their application in livestock buildings and manure-management systems. The developed systems will be tested under laboratory and practical farm conditions and validated against state-of-the-art reference measurement methods.

Your tasks

Your main responsibility will be the development, implementation and scientific validation of electronic measurement systems for agricultural emission monitoring. This includes in particular:

- Further development and optimization of modular IoT-based sensor systems for environmental and emission monitoring
- Integration of sensors, embedded electronics, data loggers, power supplies and communication interfaces into robust measurement systems
- Programming and configuration of microcontrollers, device interfaces and automated data-acquisition systems
- Planning and conducting laboratory tests, calibrations and measurement campaigns in livestock and manure-management systems
- Validation of low-cost and mid-cost sensors against state-of-the-art reference measurement instruments
- Development and implementation of quality-assurance procedures, measurement protocols and technical documentation
- Processing, quality control, statistical analysis and interpretation of measurement data
- Coordination of technical activities with project partners and preparation of scientific publications, reports and presentations

Your qualifications

- Successfully completed doctorate in electrical engineering, mechatronics, technical informatics, embedded systems, measurement and sensor technology, physical engineering or a comparable discipline
- Proven experience in scientific project management
- Proven experience in the development, integration and operation of measurement and sensor systems
- Experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers and hardware-related programming
- Knowledge of common device interfaces and communication protocols, such as I²C, SPI, UART, RS-485, Modbus, Ethernet or LoRaWAN
- Experience in sensor calibration, measurement-system validation, quality assurance and systematic troubleshooting
- Strong programming and data-analysis skills, preferably in Python, R, MATLAB, C or C++
- Very good English skills, an independent and solution-oriented working style, teamwork, willingness to conduct field measurements
- Desirable: Good command of German, EU driving licence class B

We offer

- An attractive, interdisciplinary and international working environment with a highly motivated team
- An exciting position in a cutting-edge field of environmental monitoring and sensor technology
- Excellent infrastructure with state-of-the-art laboratory and measurement technology
- Access to national and international networks for your scientific development
- Training and further education opportunities
- Family-friendly working conditions to promote work-life balance
- Financial contribution to VBB company ticket or Deutschlandticket
- A workplace at the edge of a picturesque landscape, easily accessible by bike or public transport

The full-time position (40 hours/week) is initially limited to 3 years. Part-time employment is also possible if desired. Salary will be based on your qualifications and experience according to TV-L up to pay grade 13. The preferred starting date is in Q1 2027.

For more information, please contact Dr.-Ing. David Janke (Tel.: +49 331-5699 513) and on the Internet at www.atb-potsdam.de (http://www.atb-potsdam.de) .

Then apply by 25 September 2026 with your cover letter, CV (without photo), and employment references and/or contact details of referees via our online application portal for this job posting (reference number 2026-SM-3) at https://www.atb-potsdam.de/en/career/vacancies (https://www.atb-potsdam.de/en/career/vacancies) . A Snapshot of Your Day 

As the SAP S/4HANA Rollout Cutover Lead (f/m/d), you will play a pivotal role in ensuring successful business transitions across Siemens Energy's global S4E Unify transformation program. You will define and govern the overall cutover strategy, coordinate global and local deployment activities, and ensure all business, IT, and third-party teams are fully prepared for go-live.

Working closely with Rollout Managers, Template Teams, Cluster Cutover Managers, business stakeholders, and external partners, you will oversee integrated cutover planning, manage critical dependencies and risks, and drive business readiness throughout every rollout wave. Your leadership will help ensure smooth, controlled, and low-risk transitions into the new SAP S/4HANA environment.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Own and drive the global SAP S/4HANA cutover strategy, ensuring a controlled, business-ready transition across all rollout waves
* Develop and maintain integrated cutover plans covering data migration, system validation, go-live activities, legacy system integration, and decommissioning
* Define governance, readiness criteria, key milestones, and decision gates while ensuring all deployment dependencies are managed effectively
* Identify cutover risks early, develop contingency and fallback strategies, and lead issue resolution to minimize business disruption during critical go-live periods
* Guide and support Cluster Cutover Managers by providing standardized methodologies, coordinating execution, and ensuring alignment with global deployment objectives
* Monitor cutover performance through KPIs, status reporting, and governance meetings while providing clear, decision-oriented updates to Program Management and executive stakeholders

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience
* Extensive experience leading SAP S/4HANA cutover, deployment, transition, or large-scale ERP transformation programs in complex global environments
* Strong expertise in integrated cutover planning, data migration, system validation, go-live management, legacy system integration, and operational readiness
* Proven experience in risk management, contingency planning, business continuity, milestone tracking, KPI reporting, and executive-level communication
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and coordinate business stakeholders, global delivery organizations, Cluster Cutover Managers, and external implementation partners
* Fluent English is required; German or additional languages relevant to the rollout regions are considered an advantage

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs 

The S4 program at Siemens Energy, formally called S4E or S4E‑Unify, is one of the major global Business- & IT Transformation Programs within Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions. The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.  The S4E program is delivered through phased “Unify” rollout waves, bringing sites and business areas live step by step on SAP S/4HANA. It includes standardized business templates, a defined operating model with strong governance and board‑level sponsorship, and an enhanced user experience that modernizes how employees work.

PhD-Student (m/f/d)

Join an interdisciplinary research project at the interface of neurobiology, RNA biology, and bioinformatics. The aim of this PhD project is to decipher the regulatory mechanisms underlying RNA dysregulation in response to environmental and viral stressors. Using innovative brain organoid models, you will apply computational and experimental approaches to investigate the effects of microplastics and/or HSV-1 infections on RNA regulation in models of Alzheimer's disease and healthy controls. The insights gained are expected to contribute to a better understanding of the development and progression of neurodegenerative diseases.

As part of this PhD project, you will employ state-of-the-art sequencing and analytical techniques to investigate how environmental factors and viral infections influence RNA regulation in the human brain. Particular emphasis will be placed on understanding the molecular mechanisms that may contribute to the onset and progression of neurodegenerative diseases.

- Analyze alterations in RNA regulation in the human brain using single-cell transcriptomics and long-read RNA sequencing.
- Investigate key RNA regulatory processes, including alternative splicing, RNA isoform usage, polyadenylation dynamics, and transposable element activity.
- Explore the effects of HSV-1 infections and genetic risk factors on RNA isoform diversity and regulation.
- Integrate and analyze transcriptomic and epitranscriptomic datasets to identify disease-relevant molecular mechanisms.
- Compare data from human brain organoid models with datasets from Alzheimer’s disease patients to assess the disease relevance of the models.
- Develop and apply bioinformatics approaches for the analysis of complex multi-omics datasets.
- Present and discuss research findings within the team and at national and international scientific conferences.
- Contribute to scientific publications in leading international peer-reviewed journals.
- Opportunity to expand the project to additional molecular layers, including proteomics, metabolomics, and lipidomics.
- Completed Master's degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Molecular Biology, Neuroscience, or a related field.
- Strong enthusiasm for RNA biology and research into neurodegenerative diseases.
- Hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas:
- Analysis of RNA sequencing and other omics datasets (bulk, single-cell, and/or long-read data)
- Programming and data analysis, particularly using Python and/or R
- Ability to work independently in a structured and goal-oriented manner.
- Strong teamwork and communication skills, with enthusiasm for collaborating in interdisciplinary and international research environments.
- Excellent written and spoken English skills.

Desirable Qualifications

jobs.description:
Postdoc (f/m/x) – Neuroscience, Epigenetics and Metabolic Aging

103020

Full time
39 hrs./week

Neuherberg near Munich

At Helmholtz Munich, we develop groundbreaking solutions for a healthier
society in a rapidly changing world. We believe that diverse perspectives drive
innovation. Through strong partnerships, we accelerate the transfer of new
ideas from the lab to real-life applications, improving lives.

The Institute for Diabetes and Cancer (IDC)at Helmholtz Munich aims to
elucidate the molecular mechanisms linking metabolic dysfunction, diabetes, and
tumorigenesis. The research groupMetabolic Programming across Generations
investigates how environmental and nutritional factors during early life and
across generations affect metabolic health and disease susceptibility later in
life.

We are seeking a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/x)to join our
interdisciplinary and international research team as part of a project funded
through the DZD NEXT Young Talent Program of the German Center for Diabetes
Research (DZD).

The project aims to understand whether maternal metabolic stress during early
development accelerates aging processes in the brain, particularly in brain
regions that control metabolism. Using a cross-species approach, we will
investigate the molecular and epigenetic mechanisms linking early-life
metabolic conditions to brain aging and metabolic health later in life.

The position is available from January 2027 and is funded for two years.

Your tasks

- Conduct experimental research to investigate the molecular and epigenetic
mechanisms linking early-life metabolic stress to hypothalamic aging and
metabolic health
- Perform studies in murine models, including collection, processing,
sectioning of brain tissue and anatomical analysis of hypothalamic regions
- Apply molecular, histological, and epigenetic approaches to characterize
aging-associated changes in the hypothalamus
- Analyze and integrate high-dimensional sequencing datasets, including
RNA-seq, single-cell/single-nucleus sequencing, ATAC-seq and/or ChIP-seq data
- Develop research questions independently and contribute intellectually to
the further development of the project
- Work closely with members of our research group and collaborators within
Helmholtz Munich and the DZD network
- Present and communicate research findings through publications, seminars,
and national and international scientific conferences

Your profile

- PhD in neuroscience, molecular biology, physiology, biochemistry,
bioinformatics, or a related field, with a strong interest in metabolic aging
and/or neurobiology
- Strong research experience in molecular biology, neuroscience, metabolism,
or a related field, combined with the ability to independently develop and
pursue scientific questions
- Experience with high-throughput sequencing data analysis, such as RNA-seq,
single-cell/single-nucleus RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, or ChIP-seq
- Strong scientific curiosity, problem-solving skills, and a proactive,
independent working style
- Excellent communication skills and enthusiasm for interdisciplinary
collaboration in an international research environment
- Excellent written and spoken English

Desirable qualifications

- Experience with murine models, brain tissue processing, mouse neuroanatomy,
or hypothalamic/neuroendocrine research
- Experience with immunohistochemistry, RNAscope/in situ hybridization,
metabolic phenotyping, or spatial molecular approaches
- Experience with single-cell/single-nucleus genomics and/or epigenomic data
analysis

If you fulfill all the requirements, you may be eligible for a salary grade
of up to E 13. Social benefits are based on the Collective Wage Agreement for
Public-Sector Employees (TVöD). The position has an (initial) fixed term of two
years but may be extended under certain circumstances.

Managing Director Mike Frieser:

„We believe that diversity is the key to groundbreaking research and
innovative solutions. Our flexible working models and remote options create a
supportive environment for balancing work and family life. For us, contributing
to a healthier society in such an inspiring workplace is truly meaningful.“

Get to know us

Benefits

State-of-the-art infrastructure and Core Facilities

Support with the relocation and integration process in Germany

Postdoc program, scientific training & career center with tailored offers

Sports, company doctor, mental health initiatives

On-site kindergarten, holiday care, care for the elderly

About HeyGermany

Germany urgently needs international talent. Yet complex and lengthy recognition processes prevent many qualified professionals from working in the jobs they trained for. At the same time, employers struggle to fill critical positions.

HeyGermany wants to change that. We are building the digital infrastructure to make professional recognition and work integration faster and easier. We are starting with nursing and plan to expand into other regulated professions. Our mission is to remove bureaucratic barriers and help international talent access jobs that match their qualifications.

You will take ownership of our technology and play a leading role in product development. You will work closely with the Founder & CEO on company strategy, product direction and execution. We already have a live MVP (www.hey-germany.com), an initial recognition engine and talent pool, 400+ talent pool conversions, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding. Your challenge will be to turn this foundation into a scalable technology platform that can take HeyGermany from one profession to many.

- Design and build scalable systems for qualification recognition, document processing, workflow automation and talent matching.

- Stay hands-on across the stack and make key decisions across frontend, backend, APIs, data and cloud infrastructure.

What We’re Looking For

- Engineering or a closely related technical discipline. A Master’s degree is preferred.

- Practical experience building with LLMs and modern AI systems, including RAG, agents and evaluations, and using AI effectively in your day-to-day work.
- Strong product judgment and the ability to turn customer and business problems into pragmatic product and technical decisions.

jobs.occupation: Head of Analog Design (m/f/d) - Executive (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Company Description

In September 2025, AUMOVIO emerged as a spin-off from Continental’s former Automotive group sector and has since established itself as an independent technology company. The company offers a broad portfolio for safe, exciting, connected and autonomous mobility, including sensor solutions, displays, brake and comfort systems as well as extensive expertise in software, architecture platforms and advanced driver assistance systems for software-defined vehicles. In fiscal year 2025, AUMOVIO generated sales of € 18.5 billion. Headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, AUMOVIO has around 82,000 employees at more than 80 locations worldwide.

Job Description

We are seeking an executive leader (m/f/d) with deep expertise in analog and mixed-signal integrated circuit design to lead a strategically important global organization. In this role, you will drive innovation, technology leadership, and organizational excellence while shaping next-generation semiconductor solutions for demanding automotive applications.

As Head of Analog Design (m/f/d), you will lead a global organization of highly skilled engineers across multiple locations worldwide. You will be responsible for defining and executing the organization's analog design strategy, ensuring world-class designs, engineering excellence and enabling sustainable business growth through innovative semiconductor solutions.

Key responsibilities include:

- Defining and executing the long-term Analog Design strategy aligned with business objectives
- Leading, mentoring, and developing leaders, and engineering teams across global sites
- Overseeing the complete analog IC development lifecycle from concept through production readiness
- Driving technology innovation, development excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives
- Establishing and maintaining strategic partnerships with design houses, universities, foundries, OSATs, and ecosystem partners
- Managing budgets, resource allocation, capability development, and organizational growth
- Influencing product portfolio decisions, technology roadmaps, and business case development
- Representing the company in industry forums, conferences, and strategic technology networks

Qualifications

- Academic Degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Physics, or comparable qualification
- Long term experience in semiconductor and IC development
- Experience managing substantial budgets, resources, and organizational growth
- Proven track record of bringing complex semiconductor products to mass production and building high-performing engineering organizations
- Significant leadership experience within international R&D organizations
- Demonstrated success leading diverse, geographically distributed teams
- Recognized technology and people leader (m/f/d) with deep expertise in analog design and semiconductor technologies
- Business fluent English language skills (written and spoken)
- Strong strategic thinking and business acumen
- Outstanding communication, stakeholder management, and executive leadership capabilities

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

Additional Information

- Next to the interesting daily work the region around Regensburg is offering a high recreational value and quality of life.
- Profit from extensive benefits at the location such as different canteens and cafeterias, a continuing education and training, health management, physiotherapy and much more.
- We offer an attractive salary as well as the possibility of hybrid and cross-border mobile work.
- For an improved work-life balance we support you with various initiatives for a better compatibility of family and career such as flexible work time model, part-time option, sabbatical, etc.
- You can expect a highly motivated team as well as diverse topics and projects in the global environment of the automotive industry.
- We are promoting lifelong Learning combined with personal and professional development.
- You are looking for an individual working time model? We support part-time work.

You would like to learn more about our additional services? Click here (https://www.aumovio.com/en/career/why-join-us.html) .

Ready to take your career to the next level? The future of mobility isn’t just anyone’s job. ​Make it yours! Join AUMOVIO. Own What’s Next.

jobs.occupation: Testing Operator - Space Hardware Testing (all genders) (Maschinen- und Anlagenführer/in (ohne Angabe des Schwerpunkts))
jobs.description:
html Testing Operator - Space Hardware Testing (all genders)Taufkirchen / Full-time / Permanent employee About us

Blackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.

More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.

Testing Operator - Space Hardware Testing (all genders)
Taufkirchen / Full-time / Permanent employee YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

THE WHY

We build pressure vessels and carbon structures for spaceflight. Before our hardware flies, it gets tested — and you keep the testing running. Without you, the test bench stands still.

THE WHAT

You prepare tests, help run them, and document the results. You work in the lab and at the test bench — hands-on, in a team, with real space hardware every day.

Your tasks in detail:

- Prepare and post-process the testing areas: You set up test benches and specimens, tear down after tests, and keep the testing area ready for action. → High Performance: The test bench is ready when the team needs it.
- Run and document tests: You support destructive testing and acceptance testing (NDT) and record every step cleanly. → Accountability: What was tested is documented. No gaps.
- Say what you see: Anything unusual about a specimen, the test bench, or a result — you report it right away, not when someone asks. → Candor: You raise problems before they grow.
- Support the team and infrastructure: You pitch in where needed — in the testing team and with technical infrastructure on site. → Togetherness: We win as a team.
- Learn new things: NDT methods, new test procedures, new materials — you want to grow. We'll train you. → Playfulness: Curiosity is a strength here, not a distraction.

YOUR PROFILE

- Training: Completed vocational training as a materials tester / Werkstoffprüfer (plastics, metals, or fiber composites/CFRP) or comparable technical training.
- Experience: First experience in a test lab or materials testing is a plus — not a must. What matters more: you want to learn.
- Work style: Motivated, reliable, hands-on. You want the job done — and done right.
- Team player: You enjoy working with others and help out when things get busy.
- Languages: German and English, each at B2 minimum — one of the two confident for daily work.
- On-site: This role is 100% on-site in Taufkirchen. The lab and test bench don't fit in a home office.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Creative freedom & responsibility: Autonomy, scope for decision-making and short implementation paths.
- Flexible working hours & remote option: You can work remotely by arrangement.
- Culinary variety: Lunch together with fresh, varied dishes every day.
- Attractive additional benefits: Choose between Deutschlandticket, EGYM-Well pass or a monthly top-up payment card (GivveCard).
- Knowledge exchange at the highest level: Work with experienced engineers and experts from the aerospace industry.
- Dynamic environment: Exciting projects, development opportunities and a start-up atmosphere with agile, cross-functional collaboration.
- Community & team spirit: Monthly blackout events for socialising, networking and exchange.
- Unique working atmosphere: Enjoy the end of the working day on our large roof terrace with a view of the Alps!

Please refer to reference number YF-51576 for your application.

jobs.occupation: PhD position (m/f/d) on immune reset through CAR T in chronic inflammatory diseases (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
State-of-the-art medicine and nursing care you can rely on! - Since being founded in 1815, Universitätsklinikum Erlangen has offered medicine of the highest standard and incorporated the latest insights from medical research and state-of-the-art equipment into diagnosis and therapy. More than 10.000 employees from approximately 50 different occupations are needed to provide the wide range of services offered by Universitätsklinikum Erlangen, ensuring our patients receive the very best care around the clock.

As a PhD student, you will investigate how human immune-cell networks shape tissue inflammation, regeneration and response to cellular therapies. The project will focus primarily on the human immune system and combine patient-derived material with experimental models to address mechanistic questions in cellular immunology.

Your tasks:

- Characterizing human immune-cell populations and their functional states using multiparameter flow cytometry and high-dimensional immune phenotyping.
- Investigating cellular interactions and immune networks by integrating phenotypic, functional and molecular data from immune cells and tissues.
- Studying immune responses to cellular therapies, including the mechanisms underlying immune depletion, reconstitution and tissue regeneration following CD19 CAR-T-cell therapy.
- Generating and analyzing molecular data using approaches such as bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing and other transcriptomic or spatial technologies.
- Establishing and applying experimental models to investigate mechanisms identified in human samples, including selected mouse models of intestinal inflammation, immune reconstitution and tissue regeneration after CD19 CAR-T-cell therapy.
- Developing and combining experimental and analytical approaches ranging from established methods such as ELISA, Western blotting and flow cytometry to advanced multidimensional cytometry, UMAP-based analysis and transcriptomic approaches.
- The project offers substantial scope to develop an individual scientific profile. Previous experience with these techniques is welcome, but curiosity, scientific independence, willingness to learn, and enthusiasm for understanding how immune cells interact in human disease are similarly important.

Essential experience/ qualifications:

- Above the average motivation and work ethics
- Strong theoretical and practical background in standard methods of molecular and cellular biology as well as cellular immunology
- English writing and speaking skills
- Ability to work together in a multi-national team that is supportive of one another
- A master degree (M.Sc.) in immunology, biology, molecular biology, molecular medicine or equivalent

additional advantages:

- Experience in omics data science
- Hands-on experience in human immunology

We offer:

- The position is full-time and will be payed according to salary group TVL-E 13, 65% (DFG-typical rate)
- Intended pay grade depending on qualifications and personal requierements
- Initially, the position is limited for one year, with the possibility of an extension till the degreee is achieved
- The head of the department guaranties in writing that there is funding till the degree is achieved.
- Hiring process opened and will be completed asap.
- An enthusiastic, interdisciplinary team of scientists and doctors
- High end translational research
- State-of-the-art laboratories
- Two-Stepp mentoring with a hands-on mentor (post-doc) plus the PI as supervisor with high frequent project discussions for efficient development
- Structured program for hard- and soft-skills in research (paper and grant writing classes, paper clubs, soft-skill training)
- Notes for applicants (f/m/d) ( https://www.karriere.uk-erlangen.de/bewerbung/hinweise-fuer-bewerbende/ )
- Comprehensive health promotion offers
- All benefits of the public service incl. supplementary pension plan of the Versorgungsanstalt des Bundes und der Länder (VBL) (Federal and State Government Employees' Retierment Fund)
- Family-friendly enviroment

- 5 Why Analysis

The **Children’s Hospital Augsburg (Swabian Children’s Cancer Center) **and the University of Augsburg are looking for a Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) in CAR-T Cell Therapy and Therapeutic Target Discovery in Pediatric and Rare Tumors to join our interdisciplinary research program at the interface of pediatric oncology, tumor biology, cellular therapy, therapeutic target discovery, and computational cancer biology. The position is a full-time position which is limited to two years.

The Children’s Hospital Augsburg (Swabian Children’s Cancer Center) is part of University Hospital Augsburg (UKA), a rapidly growing academic medical center with 1,699 patient beds across 22 clinics and approximately 2,800 employees. Scientifically, the hospital is a member of the NCT-WERA cooperation and thus one location of the National Center for Tumor Diseases (NCT).

**Research Environment **

- Single-cell, spatial, and multi-omic technologies are providing unprecedented opportunities to characterize tumor composition, heterogeneity, and evolution. Our research program combines these approaches with experimental tumor modeling to identify clinically actionable vulnerabilities in rare and high-risk tumors
- Our group has established a strong track record in the molecular characterization of pediatric and rare tumors, including rhabdoid tumors and other embryonal malignancies. Recent integrative studies have provided new insights into the biology and evolution of these tumors and opened avenues for therapeutic translation (Johann et al., Cancer Cell, 2016; Erkek, Johann et al., Cancer Cell, 2019; Fincke et al., Clinical Cancer Research, 2023; Mucha et al., Communications Medicine, 2025; Fincke et al., Nature Communications, 2026, accepted)
- A central goal of this position is the identification, prioritization, and experimental validation of therapeutic targets in rare entities for which effective treatment options remain limited. Relevant tumor types include DICER1-associated neoplasms, rhabdoid tumors, pediatric and rare melanomas, and other high-risk pediatric malignancies
- The successful candidate will combine molecular and computational analyses with state-of-the-art experimental approaches. CAR-T-cell therapy will represent a major experimental platform for evaluating candidate cell-surface targets and developing targeted cellular therapies
- Together with our partner institutions, we are establishing a growing biobank of patient-derived tumor organoids and other advanced tumor models, enabling systematic investigation of target expression, therapeutic efficacy, and mechanisms of resistance, including in vivo

**Your Responsibilities **

- Identify and prioritize novel therapeutic targets using integrated molecular, single-cell, spatial, and multi-omic data
- Experimentally validate candidate targets using patient-derived models, organoids, and cell lines
- Generate, engineer, and functionally characterize CAR-T cells
- Develop and optimize CAR constructs and cellular therapy strategies
- Evaluate CAR-T-cell efficacy and mechanisms of resistance in vitro and, ideally, in vivo
- Integrate experimental results with bioinformatic and computational analyses
- Develop independent research projects and contribute to grants and collaborative projects
- Publish and present research findings
- Mentor students and junior researchers where appropriate

Requirements

Mandatory

- PhD or equivalent degree in biology, molecular medicine, cancer biology, immunology, biotechnology, or a related field
- Hands-on experience in CAR-T-cell generation, engineering, and functional characterization
- Strong background in experimental cancer or cellular biology
- Experience in independent experimental research and data analysis
- Strong interest in therapeutic target discovery and translational cancer research
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills
- Excellent written and spoken English

Highly desirable

- Experience with therapeutic in vivo testing of CAR-T cells and/or xenograft models
- Experience with tumor organoids or patient-derived models
- Expertise in CAR design, viral transduction, T-cell expansion, flow cytometry, or functional immune-cell assays
- Experience in therapeutic target discovery and validation
- Familiarity with single-cell, spatial, or multi-omic approaches
- Programming skills in R or Python

What we offer

- Remuneration up to pay grade EG 13 TV-L, depending on qualifications and professional experience, including the standard social benefits provided in the public sector (occupational pension scheme and annual special payment)
- The position is initially limited to two years; an extension is intended, subject to funding and successful performance
- An interdisciplinary research environment combining experimental oncology, CAR-T-cell engineering, therapeutic target discovery, and computational cancer biology
- Integration into the research program of the University of Augsburg, with close collaboration with the University Hospital Augsburg and computational research groups
- The opportunity to work on rare and clinically challenging tumor entities, including DICER1-associated neoplasms, rhabdoid tumors, melanomas, and other high-risk pediatric malignancies
- Access to advanced patient-derived tumor models, including a growing collection of tumor organoids
- Opportunities to develop an independent academic profile, publish, present at international conferences, and contribute to grant applications
- International collaborations and opportunities for research visits with academic partner institutions

Contact

For further questions please refer to Prof. Dr. Pascal Johann (Pascal.Johann@uk-augsburg.de)

Application Deadline

Please submit your application as soon as possible, latest at the 15th of October 2026.

We look forward to you!

The position is suitable for people with severe disabilities. Applicants (m/f/d) with severe disabilities will be preferred if they are essentially the same aptitude, ability and professional performance. Women are invited to apply in accordance with Article 7 (3) BayGlG. When starting work at the Augsburg University Hospital, proof of sufficient immune protection in accordance with §§ 23, 23a IfSG must be presented or the same must be met.

Role overview

Altera is seeking an experienced Field Sales Engineer to drive growth across an assigned territory in the Central EMEA region. Depending on the candidate’s background and the business need, the role may focus primarily on either:

- Growing territory coverage, distribution customers, and channel-partner design wins; or
- Developing a defined set of strategic customers through focused demand creation and account initiatives.

The successful candidate will combine technical credibility, commercial drive, and strong relationship-building skills to turn customer and market opportunities into sustainable revenue growth.

Job responsibilities

- Develop and execute sales plans to achieve or exceed assigned revenue and design win targets.
- Identify, qualify, and pursue new business opportunities, including early-stage demand creation and design-win activity.
- Manage and grow customer accounts and, where applicable, distribution partners through strong multi-level relationships.
- Own the broader commercial relationship with strategic customers and channel partners, including pricing, contractual terms, volume commitments, supply expectations, and issue escalation.
- Understand customer needs and position Altera’s products and solutions effectively.
- Prepare and deliver sales presentations, product demonstrations, technical proposals, and business cases.
- Drive opportunities through the sales cycle, from prospecting and technical engagement through design win, negotiation, and closure.
- Build joint business plans with channel partners or account plans with strategic customers, depending on the assigned focus.
- Collaborate closely with field application engineering, applications engineering, marketing, product management, and product development.
- Maintain accurate forecasts, pipeline data, opportunity plans, and customer information in the CRM system.
- Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, and market conditions to identify opportunities and risks.
- Represent Altera at customer meetings, industry events, trade shows, and partner activities.
- Travel regularly within the assigned territory in Central EMEA.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
- At least five years of successful experience in technical sales, field applications, account management, or a comparable customer-facing role, preferably in semiconductors or embedded systems.
- Demonstrated success in meeting or exceeding sales targets.
- Strong understanding of FPGAs, SoCs, and related hardware and software design flows is highly preferred.
- Experience with distribution partners, channel ecosystems, strategic accounts, or technology-driven customer programs.
- Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
- Strong customer-development, opportunity-management, forecasting, and CRM skills.
- Self-motivated, proactive, commercially minded, and results-oriented.
- Proficiency with CRM systems such as Salesforce and Microsoft Office or comparable tools.
- Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken, is required.

Willingness to travel frequently within the assigned territory in Central EMEA.

jobs.occupation: Senior Consultant / Manager - Risk Management (Liquidity and Market Price Risk) (f|m|x) (Leiter/in - Risikomanagement)
jobs.description:
As a Senior Consultant / Manager (f|m|x), you advise our clients in
the banking sector and financial services industry on complex topics
related to liquidity and market price risk. You analyze their current
situation, identify new requirements early on and, together with your
team, develop tailored solutions – from the initial idea all the way
to implementation. In this role, you effectively drive the continued
development of your clients’ liquidity risk management, enabling
well‑founded decision-making. You assume subject-matter
responsibility, manage collaboration within the project and shape the
content development of our consulting approaches. Your tasks: You
support and lead exciting (sub-)projects at banks and financial
services providers in their liquidity and market price risk
management, taking full responsibility – from gap analyses and the
design of client-specific solutions through to implementation. You
develop integrated management approaches for liquidity and market
price risk, bank-wide liquidity risk stress tests and quantitative
modeling frameworks, for example for risk measurement or interest
rate, margin and liquidity cash flow analyses. In addition, you design
methodological frameworks (for example in the ILAAP context) and
develop solutions to implement IRRBB and CSRBB requirements as well as
net interest income (NII) simulations. As part of your role, you also
ensure the effective integration of regulatory requirements, for
instance with respect to ICAAP and ILAAP as well as IRRBB and CSRBB.
You take responsibility for your own deliverables and those of your
team and proactively advance topics. With your strong team orientation
and professionalism, you foster trust-based collaboration – both
within the team and with our clients. You also mentor junior
colleagues, developing both their professional capabilities and
personal strengths, and thus contribute to the team’s growth. You
actively help shape the ongoing enhancement of our consulting
portfolio, identify relevant market potential at an early stage and
derive concrete ideas from it. With your expertise, you support the
development of new offerings and the acquisition of new client
mandates. Your skills: You hold a degree in mathematics, (business)
informatics, physics, statistics or economics, ideally supplemented by
certifications such as FRM or CFA. You have at least three years of
professional experience in consulting or the financial industry.
Proven involvement in leading bank-specific implementation projects in
liquidity and market price risk management is an advantage, and
initial exposure to specialist leadership (for example coordinating
team members) is also part of your profile. You have a solid
understanding of liquidity and market price risk management as well as
the ICAAP and ILAAP frameworks. You confidently apply your analytical
and quantitative skills in modeling and data analysis; programming
skills in Python or R are explicitly welcome. You are familiar with
relevant European and German regulatory requirements, including EBA
Guidelines on IRRBB and CSRBB, SREP requirements, ICAAP and ILAAP.
Initial experience in dealing professionally with external audits is a
plus. You work and think in a structured and solution-oriented manner
and communicate clearly. A client- and team-oriented way of working
comes naturally to you, especially when assuming responsibility within
a team and engaging effectively with different people and situations.
You have excellent command of the German language (at least C1 level,
business-fluent proficiency) and good English language skills (at
least B2 level, fluent), both written and spoken. #LI-LARA #LI-hybrid
Your benefits Insurances & Pension Schemes: Safely on the road with
zeb—in Germany, you are also privately insured via a group accident
insurance policy. For business trips abroad, there is an additional
travel health insurance and you can also take out a company pension
plan with zeb. Mobile Work: Thanks to our technical equipment, remote
work is possible from anywhere – regardless of whether you are on
the train, at home or in the office. zeb.life: Your life is
changing—and we would like to accompany you through the different
phases. zeb.life offers you support for example in childcare, life
situation management and eldercare or in finding concierge services.
Working Time Models: The principle of "trust-based hours” applies
for all our employees, enabling flexible schedules. For permanent
employees, part-time models are also possible: you can develop your
part-time model in consultation with your CDC (Career Development

jobs.description:
The Max Planck Institute for Extraterrestrial Physics (MPE) in
Garching (near Munich), Germany, is a world-leading institute for
developing and operating state-of-the-art astronomical instruments.
Over the past years, MPE has taken a leading role in the development
of instrumentation for several international space- and ground-based
projects, for example XMM-Newton, Herschel, SRG/eROSITA, EUCLID, the
VLT telescopes (e.g. KMOS, GRAVITY) and Einstein Probe. The MPE
High-Energy group, led by Prof. K. Nandra, carries out major space
hardware programs including the development of X-ray detectors and
X-ray optics in support of its astrophysics research program. Within
the framework of ESA’s future large-class space mission New Athena,
MPE leads the international consortium developing the Wide Field
Imager (WFI), one of the two instruments aboard the X-ray satellite.
Further details about the WFI, which is based on the Max Planck
Society’s unique Silicon DEPFET technology, can be found here:
https://www.mpe.mpg.de/ATHENA-WFI/ The MPE High Energy group is
seeking an experienced Lead System Engineer for the WFI project, who
should in addition have in their earlier career stages been an
accomplished design engineer in any of the primary engineering
disciplines (electronics, optical, mechanical, control and/or software
engineering). As electronics forms the technical core of the
instrument, a design background in electronics engineering is
considered a particular asset. As the Lead System Engineer for the New
Athena WFI, you will be part of the Project Management Team. Working
as a senior member of the WFI team, reporting to the Principal
Investigator and the Project Manager, you will have ample
opportunities to innovate and develop new technical solutions. Lead
System Engineer (m/f/d) for the NEW ATHENA-WFI satellite project Job
Code: 18/2026 Your Tasks: Act as the technical authority for the whole
WFI instrument, establishing, maintaining and controlling the
instrument-level technical baseline throughout the project lifecycle.
Be responsible for the project's technical configuration management.
Work in close and continuous collaboration with the Project Manager,
Project Scientist and the engineering team. Requirements engineering.
Definition and control of technical interfaces (external:
WFI-to-spacecraft; internal: between WFI sub-systems), ensuring
consistency across all responsible sub-system teams. Application of
end-to-end systems analysis and modelling and the subsequent
allocation and management of technical budgets/​tolerances.
Definition of the verification requirements and success criteria that
integration and test plans must satisfy, in coordination with the MAIT
Manager. Support of system integration, verification and testing,
acting as the primary technical interface towards ESA and consortium
partners. Technical Management and Risk Assessment. Prepare technical
documentation for milestones and reviews, assist the Project Manager
with schedule development and resource planning, and monitor
engineering progress against the project schedule, coordinating the
technical actions needed to support timely achievement of engineering
milestones. Your Qualifications: Essential: A completed scientific
university degree (M.Sc. or Dipl.‑Ing.) in engineering or an
equivalent qualification with in‑depth knowledge of scientific
instrumentation development. A physics degree with applicable work
experience in instrumentation development will also be considered.
Desirable: Given that electronics is the technical core of the
instrument, prior design experience in electronics engineering is
regarded as a particular asset, though applicants with a strong
background in the other primary engineering disciplines are equally
encouraged to apply. A higher degree (Ph.D.) in System Engineering
would be an advantage. Knowledge and Experience: Successful candidate
is expected to bring proven systems engineering experience with
designing astronomical or other complex systems. Knowledge of:
Engineering management with a broad knowledge of the technologies
involved in the engineering activities being managed. Principles and
methods of systems engineering and requirements analysis. Technical
risk assessment. Modelling languages, and relevant software tools.
Characterisation methods to evaluate candidate design alternatives.
System integration, tools, test equipment, principles and methods of
validation. Knowledge of ESA design and quality requirements (ECSS
standards) is an advantage. Electronics design principles
(analogue/​digital, front-end and detector electronics) are
considered particularly relevant, given the central role of
electronics in the instrument. Skills: Very good communication skills.
Planning, organising resources, motivating people, measuring
performance and applying corrections where necessary. The ability to
balance technical, schedule, resource and contractual considerations,
and a clear understanding of when a technical decision needs to be
escalated — to the Project Manager or, in more significant cases, to
the Project Office. Fluency in written and spoken English. Fluency in
written and spoken German will be an advantage but is not essential.
We offer: A versatile, challenging and autonomous job in a dynamic and
culturally stimulating international research environment in the
development of satellite instrumentation. Interdisciplinary work in a
team of experienced engineers and physicists. Needs-oriented training
opportunities. Fair payment according to your qualifications and
professional experience in accordance with the collective agreement
for the public service up to pay group 14 (TVöD Bund). Company
pension scheme (VBL). Underground station U6 directly in front of the
institute. Canteen in the immediate vicinity. Reduced rates for
certain insurance policies. Free parking on the institute grounds. The

The Academic Partnership organization at SAP is the bridge connecting SAP and academia. About us At No Isolation, we’re a profitable, 65-person Scandinavian
EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring
learning and belonging to every child. Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19
countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance,
belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be
physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it
bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both
educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.
We’re established enough to have a proven solution and strong
financial foundations, yet still small enough for every new colleague
to have a visible impact on our next stage of growth. The Opportunity

- Account (Sales) Manager (m/w/d) We are already quite established in
Germany. With 1,500+ units already deployed nationwide with almost no
churn across strategic customers, it’s a proven, trusted, and loved
solution - used by teachers who need a reliable way to include absent
students, welcomed by families who feel their child is still
"there,” and embraced by pupils who can see, speak, and belong
again. The references are real, and the impact is repeatable at scale.
Our next chapter is expanding our footprint in Baden-Württemberg - a
strategic, organic expansion that extends what already works. It
represents a massive and vital opportunity for our mission. We’re
bringing the same quality, reliability, and outcomes that defined
success elsewhere, and we’re looking for a sales professional to
play a pivotal role in driving growth across the region. As Account
Manager, you will set your strategic focus, open executive-level doors
across education and public authorities, and orchestrate
multi-stakeholder decisions. Your craft is relationships: You’ll
cultivate a high-trust network across all your stakeholders - engaging
in person to move complex decisions forward. You will lead with rigor,
listen with empathy, and with executive credibility, you’ll turn
early wins into lighthouse references, and lay the operating cadence
that keeps momentum compounding year after year. What You’ll Do
Define and drive your territory strategy: Build and execute the
go-to-market plan for your focus area within the region -
segmentation, territory mapping, prioritizing key accounts, and
setting milestones that turn strategic goals into tangible outcomes.
Build strategic executive relationships: Build trust with education
authorities, municipal leaders, and school executives - map decision
paths, align to policy and budget cycles, and secure multi-level
sponsorship. Win and expand strategic accounts: Lead full-cycle
acquisition and growth; align executive sponsors, budget owners, and
procurement; run multi-stakeholder close plans to signed agreements.

with proven methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN, Challenger)
to pressure-test value, control timelines, and move from business case
to signed terms. Collaborate for seamless delivery and growth: Partner
with Customer Success, Marketing, and Product teams to ensure smooth
onboarding and implementation, capture outcomes, and turn success into
expansion and credible references. Create regional momentum: Build a
trusted partner network (associations, advocacy groups, integrators)
to accelerate adoption, and build visible presence by speaking at and
hosting conferences, roundtables, and policy forums to shape the
inclusion agenda. What You Bring New-business track record with
long-tail sales cycles (Germany): Solid B2B experience - creating and
closing multi-stakeholder deals, managing long cycles, and driving
consensus to close. Experience selling to the educational or public
sector will be a strong advantage. Executive relationship builder:
Ability to build credibility and earn trust from C-suite to school
leaders - advancing complex decisions through purposeful face-to-face
engagement and secure executive sponsorship. Strategic GTM & execution
discipline: Ability to build a targeted GTM strategy and turn it into
an operating rhythm - market segmentation, decision-maker mapping,
phased milestones, pipeline hygiene, and accurate forecasting
(HubSpot). Structured, consultative selling: Ability to run structured
discovery and build quantified ROI cases; experience with
methodologies such as MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN or Challenger is
beneficial. Language & location: Native-level German and professional
English; based anywhere within the Baden-Württemberg region. What We
Offer Proven platform: Expand within Baden-Württemberg with national
credibility, strong references, delivery expertise, and clear demand.

autonomy and decision-making responsibility. Growth & development:
Access to enablement, coaching, industry events, and opportunities to
